summary: Package the artifact: in `/tmp/backups/artifact` write `sha256sum.txt` for all `*.pgc` files, then `tar cf artifact.tar artifact`, `sha256sum artifact.tar > artifact.tar.sha256`, verify with `sha256sum --check` and `tar tvf`, and copy both files to the target with `scp`.
questions: How do I package the AAP migration artifact?
How do I create checksums for the migration artifact?
How do I transfer the artifact to the target?

answer_card.title: Package the artifact
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cd /tmp/backups/artifact/
[ -f sha256sum.txt ] && rm -f sha256sum.txt
find . -type f -name "*.pgc" -exec sha256sum {} \; >> sha256sum.txt
cd ..
tar cf artifact.tar artifact
sha256sum artifact.tar > artifact.tar.sha256
sha256sum --check artifact.tar.sha256
tar tvf artifact.tar
```
Copy `artifact.tar` and `artifact.tar.sha256` to the target (e.g. `scp`).
